
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/greatsql/p/22560356" title="发布于 2026-08-19 08:11">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">实测GreatSQL 8.4.4-5新特性：大事务binlog独立落盘</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        GreatSQL 8.4.4-5 新版本带来了「大事务 binlog独立落盘」特性。核心思路一句话：不再回读重写，而是把 binlog cache 文件直接“转正“成 binlog文件。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h3 id="业务痛点">业务痛点</h3>
<p>在以前，使用 MySQL 处理大事务时，一般会出现数据库整体性能卡顿问题：单个大事务提交会引发全库 TPS 剧烈抖动，普通事务提交被大事务阻塞，磁盘 I/O 负载急剧增高，高并发业务场景下该现象尤为严重。 根源在于原生 binlog 提交流程存在固有缺陷：</p>
<ol>
<li>大事务产生的binlog数据先写入 binlog cache 由于溢出内存写入临时文件，提交阶段需要重新读取 cache 内容，再写入正式 binlog 文件，产生双倍磁盘写入，造成严重写放大、I/O 资源浪费；</li>
<li>二次读写流程执行周期长，会长期持有全局 binlog 锁，阻塞其他所有事务提交；</li>
<li>I/O 阻塞 + 锁竞争叠加，导致数据库吞吐量剧烈波动，业务响应延迟。</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="greatsql解决方案大事务-binlog-独立落盘">GreatSQL解决方案：大事务 binlog 独立落盘</h3>
<p>GreatSQL 8.4.4-5 推出<strong>大事务 binlog 独立落盘</strong>优化特性，彻底消除原生 binlog 二次读写带来的性能损耗。</p>
<h4 id="核心优化思路">核心优化思路</h4>
<p>优化传统「binlog cache溢出落盘→ binlog cache 读取 → 写入 binlog 文件」流程，预构建完整结构的 binlog cache 临时文件，事务满足阈值后直接将 cache 文件重命名为正式 binlog 文件，消除二次写 I/O，大幅缩短事务提交时间。</p>
<h4 id="底层关键改造">底层关键改造</h4>
<ol>
<li><strong>可重构 Cache 文件结构</strong> 写入 binlog cache 时提前预留文件头、描述事件、GTID 相关事件、对齐填充位等标准 binlog 必备结构，cache 文件天然符合正式 binlog 文件格式，无需二次加工改写。</li>
<li><strong>文件直接 Rename 落盘机制</strong> 当事务达到阈值，先结束当前正在写入的 binlog 文件，向 cache 预留空间补全头部事件，通过文件重命名操作直接将 cache 临时文件转为正式 binlog，省去数据复制写入动作。</li>
</ol>
<h4 id="特性预期收益">特性预期收益</h4>
<ol>
<li>大事务提交延迟降低 30%~70%；</li>
<li>高并发混合事务场景整体 TPS 提升 10%~40%；</li>
<li>消除 binlog 写放大，磁盘 I/O 显著下降，消除大事务对业务 TPS 冲击问题。</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="使用方法">使用方法</h3>
<p>GreatSQL增加了系统变量：<code>binlog_large_commit_threshold</code></p>
<ul>
<li>变量类型：无符号长整型（ulonglong），取值范围 10485760 ~ 18446744073709551615</li>
<li>默认值：128MB</li>
<li>作用逻辑：当单个事务 binlog 数据大小达到该阈值，自动启用大事务 binlog 独立落盘优化逻辑。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="实测binlog独立落盘">实测binlog独立落盘</h2>
<h3 id="binlog独立落盘">binlog独立落盘</h3>
<p>系统变量binlog_large_commit_threshold设置了binlog独立落盘的阈值，binlog大小超过此值，GreatSQL会将该事务的binlog独立落盘。</p>
<pre><code class="language-SQL">-- binlog_large_commit_threshold的默认值是128M
greatsql&gt; SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'binlog_large_commit_threshold';
+-------------------------------+-----------+
| Variable_name                 | Value     |
+-------------------------------+-----------+
| binlog_large_commit_threshold | 134217728 |
+-------------------------------+-----------+
1 row in set (0.01 sec)
</code></pre>
<p>执行一个超过128M的大事务</p>
<pre><code class="language-SQL">-- 检查binlog信息，最新binlog是binlog.000003
greatsql&gt; SHOW BINARY LOGS;
+---------------+-----------+-----------+
| Log_name      | File_size | Encrypted |
+---------------+-----------+-----------+
| binlog.000001 |  19082048 | No        |
| binlog.000002 | 190815557 | No        |
| binlog.000003 |       158 | No        |
+---------------+-----------+-----------+
3 rows in set (0.00 sec)

-- 执行一个大事务
greatsql&gt;INSERT INTO test2 SELECT * FROM test1;
Query OK, 1000000 rows affected (25.41 sec)
Records: 1000000  Duplicates: 0  Warnings: 0

-- 检查binglog，发现事务未写入binlog.000003，而是写入了binlog.000004
greatsql&gt; SHOW BINARY LOGS;
+---------------+-----------+-----------+
| Log_name      | File_size | Encrypted |
+---------------+-----------+-----------+
| binlog.000001 |  19082048 | No        |
| binlog.000002 | 190815557 | No        |
| binlog.000003 |       391 | No        |
| binlog.000004 | 190725193 | No        |
+---------------+-----------+-----------+
4 rows in set (0.00 sec)
</code></pre>
<h3 id="对比大事务对tps的影响">对比大事务对TPS的影响</h3>
<h4 id="执行大事务不使用binlog独立落盘">执行大事务，不使用binlog独立落盘</h4>
<pre><code class="language-SQL">-- 设置binlog独立落盘的阈值1G
greatsql&gt; SET GLOBAL binlog_large_commit_threshold=1024*1024*1024;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

greatsql&gt; SHOW BINARY LOGS;
+---------------+-----------+-----------+
| Log_name      | File_size | Encrypted |
+---------------+-----------+-----------+
| binlog.000001 |  19082048 | No        |
| binlog.000002 | 190815557 | No        |
| binlog.000003 |       391 | No        |
| binlog.000004 | 190725403 | No        |
| binlog.000005 | 443557932 | No        |
+---------------+-----------+-----------+
5 rows in set (0.00 sec)

greatsql&gt; TRUNCATE TABLE test2;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.05 sec)

-- 执行大事务，但该事务小于binlog_large_commit_threshold（1G)
greatsql&gt; SELECT now();INSERT INTO test2 SELECT * FROM test1;select now();
+---------------------+
| now()               |
+---------------------+
| 2026-08-13 12:18:26 |
+---------------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

Query OK, 1000000 rows affected (30.22 sec)
Records: 1000000  Duplicates: 0  Warnings: 0

+---------------------+
| now()               |
+---------------------+
| 2026-08-13 12:18:56 |
+---------------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

-- 事务没有独立落盘，写到了binlog.000005 
greatsql&gt; SHOW BINARY LOGS;
+---------------+-----------+-----------+
| Log_name      | File_size | Encrypted |
+---------------+-----------+-----------+
| binlog.000001 |  19082048 | No        |
| binlog.000002 | 190815557 | No        |
| binlog.000003 |       391 | No        |
| binlog.000004 | 190725403 | No        |
| binlog.000005 | 659791246 | No        |
+---------------+-----------+-----------+
5 rows in set (0.00 sec)
</code></pre>
<p>对sysbench测试TPS的影响</p>
<pre><code class="language-YAML">2026-08-13 12:18:53 [ 33s ] thds: 10 tps: 480.99 qps: 9606.80 (r/w/o: 6725.86/1918.96/961.98) lat (ms,95%): 19.65 err/s: 0.00 reconn/s: 0.00
2026-08-13 12:18:54 [ 34s ] thds: 10 tps: 462.02 qps: 9243.42 (r/w/o: 6470.29/1849.08/924.04) lat (ms,95%): 17.63 err/s: 0.00 reconn/s: 0.00
2026-08-13 12:18:55 [ 35s ] thds: 10 tps: 471.95 qps: 9486.03 (r/w/o: 6648.32/1893.81/943.90) lat (ms,95%): 18.95 err/s: 0.00 reconn/s: 0.00
2026-08-13 12:18:56 [ 36s ] thds: 10 tps: 135.01 qps: 2640.23 (r/w/o: 1840.16/530.05/270.02) lat (ms,95%): 861.95 err/s: 0.00 reconn/s: 0.00
2026-08-13 12:18:57 [ 37s ] thds: 10 tps: 791.87 qps: 15849.30 (r/w/o: 11098.10/3167.47/1583.73) lat (ms,95%): 17.01 err/s: 0.00 reconn/s: 0.00
2026-08-13 12:18:58 [ 38s ] thds: 10 tps: 507.26 qps: 10140.24 (r/w/o: 7094.66/2032.06/1013.52) lat (ms,95%): 17.32 err/s: 0.00 reconn/s: 0.00
2026-08-13 12:18:59 [ 39s ] thds: 10 tps: 499.13 qps: 9991.69 (r/w/o: 7002.88/1989.53/999.27) lat (ms,95%): 16.41 err/s: 0.00 reconn/s: 0.00
2026-08-13 12:19:00 [ 40s ] thds: 10 tps: 468.96 qps: 9385.18 (r/w/o: 6562.43/1884.84/937.92) lat (ms,95%): 17.63 err/s: 0.00 reconn/s: 0.00
</code></pre>
<p>在事务完成的时间点（2026-08-13 12:18:56），TPS被明显拉低，由约470降低到135，降低约70% 。</p>
<h4 id="执行大事务使用binlog独立落盘">执行大事务，使用binlog独立落盘</h4>
<pre><code class="language-SQL">-- 设置binlog独立落盘的阈值10M
greatsql&gt; SET GLOBAL binlog_large_commit_threshold=10*1024*1024;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)


greatsql&gt; SHOW BINARY LOGS;
+---------------+-----------+-----------+
| Log_name      | File_size | Encrypted |
+---------------+-----------+-----------+
| binlog.000001 |  19082048 | No        |
| binlog.000002 | 190815557 | No        |
| binlog.000003 |       391 | No        |
| binlog.000004 | 190725403 | No        |
| binlog.000005 | 659791246 | No        |
+---------------+-----------+-----------+
5 rows in set (0.00 sec)

greatsql&gt; TRUNCATE TABLE test2;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.03 sec)

-- 执行一个大事务（约198M）
greatsql&gt; SELECT now();INSERT INTO test2 SELECT * FROM test1;select now();
+---------------------+
| now()               |
+---------------------+
| 2026-08-13 12:21:53 |
+---------------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

Query OK, 1000000 rows affected (27.34 sec)
Records: 1000000  Duplicates: 0  Warnings: 0

+---------------------+
| now()               |
+---------------------+
| 2026-08-13 12:22:20 |
+---------------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

-- 大事务没有写入binlog.000005，写到了binlog.000006 
greatsql&gt; SHOW BINARY LOGS;
+---------------+-----------+-----------+
| Log_name      | File_size | Encrypted |
+---------------+-----------+-----------+
| binlog.000001 |  19082048 | No        |
| binlog.000002 | 190815557 | No        |
| binlog.000003 |       391 | No        |
| binlog.000004 | 190725403 | No        |
| binlog.000005 | 676207441 | No        |
| binlog.000006 | 208456762 | No        |
+---------------+-----------+-----------+
6 rows in set (0.01 sec)
</code></pre>
<p>对sysbench测试TPS的影响</p>
<pre><code class="language-YAML">2026-08-13 12:22:16 [ 34s ] thds: 10 tps: 450.49 qps: 9003.74 (r/w/o: 6297.80/1804.96/900.98) lat (ms,95%): 18.61 err/s: 0.00 reconn/s: 0.00

2026-08-13 12:22:25 [ 43s ] thds: 10 tps: 425.99 qps: 8562.86 (r/w/o: 5996.91/1713.97/851.99) lat (ms,95%): 29.19 err/s: 0.00 reconn/s: 0.00
</code></pre>
<p>在事务完成时间点（2026-08-13 12:22:20），TPS没有降低，大事务对TPS的冲击消失。</p>
<h3 id="测试总结">测试总结</h3>
<p>经对比测试验证，GreatSQL 大事务 binlog 独立落盘特性效果显著。该特性通过文件结构预构建与文件直接 rename 落盘的优化方式，彻底消除 binlog 二次写入带来的IO写放大问题，大幅减少大事务提交对全局事务的阻塞影响，有效规避了大事务提交引发的吞吐量波动，彻底消除大事务对业务整体TPS稳定性的冲击，确保数据库高并发TP业务场景的平稳运行。</p>
